test_cases.steps:
Chuẩn bị: Contractor violation V-A-001 of kind DELAY with a sanction in status PROPOSED; supporting document DOC-V-01 in the document store.
1. Confirm V-A-001 without a document
2. Attach DOC-V-01 and confirm again
3. Open the contractor scorecard for the period
test_cases.expected: Step 1: 422 VALIDATION_FAILED and V-A-001 stays PROPOSED. Step 2: 200 and V-A-001 is CONFIRMED with document_id DOC-V-01. Step 3: the scorecard lists V-A-001 once.
